item.neoecoprototype.simplify_structure_:
Use it on a multi-block host that is already formed.
[Shift + right-click]
Not built out: builds the shape all the way to its maximum length in one go.
Already built out: upgrades it in place to L9.
[What is swapped]
The blocks taken out go back into your inventory; the new parts are taken from it.
[Protection when parts are missing]
When you cannot pay, not one block is taken apart.
It spends 1 paper and 1 blank pattern, and adds a made-up crafting pattern for the work order at hand.
(Note: the parts you already have go in, one work order comes out)

gui.neoecoprototype.dissociator_catalyst: Catalyst: a permanent bonus part, never consumed
Sneak-right-click a network device to mark it, then sneak-right-click a second one to join the two without a cable. The card charges nothing: a link carries whatever channels AE2 gives the two devices at its ends, and one device may hold at most 4 links. Sneak-right-click an AE2 controller to lift that network one step (8 channels per face, then 16, 24, 32). Sneak-right-click the marked device again to drop every link it carries. A network with no AE2 controller fits only 8 devices, and this card cannot lift that: put an AE2 controller into the network and the cap goes away entirely.

Whether a link is live is not what the device panel shows: sneak-right-click that device with this card and the reply reads wirelessLinks=n live=m, where only live= counts - and that click also marks it as the anchor.
Wireless ME links are switched off in the config of this world (wireless_links), so using this card does nothing right now.
No device is marked yet, so there is no network to ask: sneak-right-click a device with this card first.
item.neoecoprototype.migration_drive.des:
Use on a formed multiblock host that already spans its full length.
[Shift + right click]
Takes it up one rung as asked, on all three families. Every block the swap replaces goes back into your inventory, and what is mounted stays where it was - a storage matrix in its drive, the patterns in their buses.
[This drive is the price]
It is a consumable.
[What is cleared]
The communication interface's information is lost.
item.neoecoprototype.migration_drive_cre:
Use on a formed multiblock host that already spans its full length.
[Shift + right click]
Skips the rungs in between and puts this machine on L9, on all three families.
[Creative power]
It holds a secret of the research system.
